note: Draft recipes for development, written from the analysis examples. A dietitian must write and sign the real collection; production refuses this file. Amounts are for the whole dish, never per person. Steps carry no amounts.

recipes.name: Aloo Pyaz ki Sabji (dry, light)
steps: Heat the oil, add jeera, then the sliced onion; cook till soft.
Add the cubed potato with haldi, dhania powder, chilli powder and salt, and a splash of water.
Cover and cook for 12 to 15 minutes till the potato is soft, stirring now and then.
recipes.why_it_fits: Dry preparation keeps the oil low.

recipes.name: Bhindi Sabji (dry)
steps: Wash the bhindi and dry it fully, then cut it into small pieces.
Heat the oil, add jeera, then the onion; cook till soft.
Add the bhindi, haldi, dhania powder and chilli powder; cook uncovered on low heat, stirring gently, till tender.
Add salt at the end so the bhindi stays crisp.
recipes.why_it_fits: Fibre-rich and cooked with little oil.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobhi (dry)
steps: Heat the oil, add jeera and the grated ginger.
Add the cauliflower florets and cubed potato with haldi, dhania powder, chilli powder and salt.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes till both are soft, stirring now and then.
recipes.why_it_fits: Mixes a starchy vegetable with a fibre-rich one.

recipes.name: Lauki Chana Dal
steps: Soak the chana dal for an hour.
Pressure-cook the dal with the cubed lauki, haldi and salt till soft.
Heat the oil, add jeera, the chopped tomato and chilli powder; cook till soft and pour over the dal.
recipes.why_it_fits: Filling, with protein from the dal.

recipes.name: Cabbage Matar Sabji
steps: Heat the oil, add jeera and the slit green chilli.
Add the shredded cabbage, peas, haldi and salt; mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat for about 10 minutes till just soft.
recipes.why_it_fits: Mostly fibre-rich vegetables, cooked with little oil.

recipes.name: Palak Sabji (dry)
steps: Wash and chop the palak.
Heat the oil, add jeera, garlic and the onion; cook till soft.
Add the palak, chilli powder and salt; cook uncovered till the water dries.
recipes.why_it_fits: A fill-up green vegetable, cooked dry.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Tadka
steps: Pressure-cook the moong dal with haldi and salt till soft.
Heat the ghee, add jeera, garlic, onion and tomato; cook till soft.
Pour the tadka over the dal and mix.
recipes.why_it_fits: Protein from the dal, with a small tadka.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer Bhurji
steps: Heat the oil, add jeera and the chopped tomato; cook till soft.
Add the chopped palak and cook till wilted.
Crumble in the paneer with salt and mix for a few minutes.
